# Vendored d3

Generated by `tools/vendor-d3.mjs` -- do not edit by hand.

Sources copied verbatim from node_modules; only bare import specifiers were
rewritten to relative paths so every package shares ONE d3-selection module
instance. That sharing is load-bearing: d3-transition and d3-drag patch
`selection.prototype` (.transition/.interrupt/.drag), and those patches are
only visible to the app if it imports the same module instance.

Versions:

- d3-selection@3.0.0
- d3-transition@3.0.1
- d3-zoom@3.0.0
- d3-force@3.0.0
- d3-drag@3.0.0
- d3-dispatch@3.0.1
- d3-interpolate@3.0.1
- d3-color@3.1.0
- d3-ease@3.0.1
- d3-timer@3.0.1
- d3-quadtree@3.0.1
